description: Record log vectors: entries, signed checkpoints (C2SP signed-note), inclusion and consistency proofs in the HTTP API format, and cases that must fail. Hashes are standard base64. Generated by `python -m d2_record.vectors`; test keys are public.

invalid.reason: the proof is claimed for another position
the proof has an extra hash
the proof is missing a hash
the entry was edited after signing
the entry's payload hash was swapped
the checkpoint is signed by another key with the same name
the checkpoint body was edited after signing
the proof is for another tree size
the consistency proof is missing a hash
the consistency proof has an extra hash
old and new checkpoints are swapped
the new checkpoint does not match the proof
